# Aggregate

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The count an aggregated event carries. Counts are exact: every
occurrence is in exactly one aggregate or one single event.

Appears at: `/aggregate`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cmdline_samples` | array of string | no |  | at most 3 items | 1.4.0 | Up to 3 distinct command lines seen among the occurrences, after redaction. |
| `count` | integer | yes |  | at least 1; format `uint64` | 1.4.0 | The occurrences this event stands for, at least 1. |
| `first_seen` | [`Timestamp`](types.md#timestamp) | yes |  |  | 1.4.0 | When the first of them happened. |
| `kind` | [`AggregateKind`](types.md#aggregatekind) | yes |  |  | 1.4.0 | Summary or repeat. |
| `last_seen` | [`Timestamp`](types.md#timestamp) | yes |  |  | 1.4.0 | When the last of them happened. |
| `partial` | constant | no |  | always `true` | 1.4.0 | A partial summary, written before its window closed so a crash loses no counts. A later event for the same window carries the counts since. |
| `window_secs` | integer | no |  | at least 0; format `uint32` | 1.4.0 | The window it covers, in seconds, for a summary. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
